answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks sybil attackers at the entry vertex of the agent economy. Each new agent locks a 20 POA deposit that only unlocks after 30 days of steady, distinctive behavior: timing, tool choices and style must form a stable fingerprint no bot farm can fake at scale. Minting 1,000 fake identities costs 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one refundable 20 POA deposit. The long voyage proves the traveler, so honest agents join cheaply and fakes stay on the ledge outside.
